Attributes.Name: TBox Evaluation Tool
Attributes.Description:
Performs a boolean evaluation of mathematical expressions. Examples:
(1<2)
{B[min]}==10
{B[min]}>{B[max]}!="true"
{B[min]}<100 && {B[max]} > 200

Attributes.Name: Directory
Attributes.Description: The directory in which the file is located or should be written

Attributes.Name: File
Attributes.Description: Name of the file

Attributes.Name: Text
Attributes.Description: Content of the File that should be created (ActionMode Input) or read (ActionMode Buffer or Verify)

Attributes.Name: Encoding
Attributes.Description: [Optional] Encoding that should be used to read/write the file

Attributes.Name: Overwrite
Attributes.Description: [Optional] Can be used in combination with creating a file. If a file already exists and overwrite is not set or set to 'False' an error will be thrown. If set to 'True' the file will be created anyway.

Attributes.Name: Add Byte Order Mark
Attributes.Description:
[Optional] Can be used in combination with creating a file which has UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoding.
True: a BOM (Byte Order Mark) will be added to the file's preamble.
False: a BOM will not be added.
Not set: UTF-16 will have BOM added by default. For UTF-8, no BOM is added by default.
